scope_note: Economic-nexus reference for remote sellers. Seller withholding is treated as the duty to collect and remit sales/use tax, not income or payroll tax withholding. State Thresholds for Filing is a registration/collection nexus screening label and does not determine sales-tax return filing frequency or due dates.
audit_note: v1.3.1 scope/UX hardening preserves the v1.3.0 audited structured rules model and state records while clarifying the product as an economic-nexus early-warning/watchlist tool, replacing ambiguous withholding-focused language, and making below-threshold results explicitly non-conclusive for other nexus bases or omitted facts.

states.sales_basis: Retail sales delivered into Alabama; marketplace sales collected by participating marketplace generally excluded from seller threshold
states.collection_timing: Threshold is measured using the previous calendar year; qualifying remote sellers must register and collect Alabama sellers use tax for covered sales
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace-facilitator rules can shift collection duty to facilitator; direct sales remain relevant
states.source_title: Alabama DOR – Remote Seller FAQ
states.notes: Physical presence triggers registration regardless of economic threshold.

states.sales_basis: All gross sales of goods, property, products, or services delivered in Alaska, including marketplace-facilitated sales, regardless of taxability or end-buyer status
states.collection_timing: Register/collect for participating local jurisdictions under the Alaska Remote Seller Sales Tax Code
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace-facilitated sales are included in the statewide $100,000 threshold; collection applies for participating ARSSTC local jurisdictions
states.source_title: Alaska Remote Seller Sales Tax Commission – Business/Sellers
states.notes: No statewide sales tax; local municipality participation is essential.

states.sales_basis: Gross sales into Arizona; marketplace-facilitated sales are generally excluded from an individual seller threshold when the facilitator collects
states.collection_timing: Obtain TPT license once threshold is met; begin remitting on first day of a month beginning at least 30 days after threshold is met
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace-facilitator sales are generally excluded from an individual marketplace seller's threshold where facilitator collects
states.source_title: Arizona DOR – Out-of-State Sellers
states.notes: Threshold stepped down from $200k (2019) to $150k (2020) to $100k (2021+).

states.sales_basis: Taxable sales into Arkansas
states.collection_timing: Generally next transaction after threshold is met
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales collected by facilitator are generally excluded from seller's own collection duty
states.source_title: Arkansas DFA – Remote Sellers and Marketplace Facilitators
states.notes: Either dollar or transaction test can create economic nexus.

states.sales_basis: Combined sales of tangible personal property for delivery in California by retailer and related persons
states.collection_timing: Register and collect once threshold is exceeded; current $500k rule operative under AB 147
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace-facilitator rules apply separately; combined-sales computation can include related persons
states.source_title: CDTFA – Wayfair / Use Tax Collection Requirements
states.notes: AB 147 raised the threshold to $500,000 and eliminated the transaction threshold.

states.sales_basis: Retail sales into Colorado
states.collection_timing: Begin collection on the first day of the month after the 90th day following the point the current-year Colorado retail-sales threshold is exceeded.
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace-facilitator collection may exclude facilitated sales from seller's direct collection responsibilities
states.source_title: Colorado DOR – Out-of-State Businesses
states.notes: Home-rule local jurisdictions and Colorado's destination sourcing rules require separate attention.

states.sales_basis: Gross receipts from retail sales into Connecticut
states.collection_timing: If both tests are met for the measurement period, registration/collection generally applies from October 1
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales can count toward threshold even where facilitator collects
states.source_title: Connecticut DRS – Registering with DRS
states.notes: Connecticut is unusual because both the dollar and transaction tests must be met.

states.sales_basis: No state sales/use tax
states.collection_timing: No Delaware sales-tax collection requirement; other business taxes may apply
states.marketplace_note: N/A for state sales tax
states.source_title: Delaware Division of Revenue – Exemption Certificates / No Sales Tax
states.notes: Delaware imposes gross receipts and other taxes even though it has no sales tax.

states.sales_basis: Gross receipts from retail sales into D.C.
states.collection_timing: Generally beginning with the next transaction after threshold is met
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace-facilitator rules may shift collection to facilitator
states.source_title: DC OTR – Sales and Use Tax FAQs
states.notes: Current D.C. OTR FAQ and Wayfair notice use “more than 200” separate retail sales. An independent 2026 secondary benchmark describes “200 or more.” The analyzer applies the official >200 rule but conservatively flags exactly 200 retail sales for human review.

states.sales_basis: Taxable remote sales of tangible personal property delivered into Florida
states.collection_timing: Register and collect beginning with the applicable calendar year after the prior-year threshold is met
states.marketplace_note: Facilitator collects for facilitated sales; marketplace seller's direct Florida sales remain relevant
states.source_title: Florida DOR – Sales and Use Tax
states.notes: Florida's remote-seller economic nexus law took effect July 1, 2021.

states.sales_basis: Retail sales of tangible personal property delivered electronically or physically into Georgia, whether taxable or exempt; marketplace sales generally excluded for individual sellers

states.sales_basis: Gross income/proceeds from Hawaii-delivered property, Hawaii-used services, or Hawaii-used intangibles

states.source_title: Idaho State Tax Commission – Online Sellers Guide

states.sales_basis: Retail sales of tangible personal property to Illinois purchasers under the remote-retailer rules; marketplace sales generally excluded for individual sellers

states.source_title: Illinois DOR – FY 2026-12
states.notes: The 200-transaction test was eliminated effective 2026-01-01.

states.sales_basis: Gross revenue from sales into Indiana

states.notes: Transaction-count threshold removed effective 2024-01-01.

states.measurement_period: Current or immediately preceding calendar year

states.measurement_period: Current or immediately preceding calendar year

states.sales_basis: Gross receipts from sales into Kentucky
states.collection_timing: Register and begin collection no later than the first day of the calendar month that is at most 60 days after the $100,000 threshold is reached.
states.marketplace_note: 2026 legislation also removed the transaction test for marketplace providers

states.sales_basis: Gross sales of goods or services delivered into Louisiana for remote sellers

states.sales_basis: Maine sales of tangible personal property, electronically transferred products, and taxable services
states.collection_timing: First day of first month beginning at least 30 days after threshold is exceeded
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales for which facilitator collects are generally excluded from seller's own collection/reporting
states.source_title: Maine Revenue Services – Guidance for Remote Sellers
states.notes: Older agency guidance may still display historical transaction-test language; use current statute.

states.sales_basis: Gross revenue from tangible personal property or taxable services delivered in Maryland
states.collection_timing: Begin collection on the first day of the month following the month in which the economic-nexus threshold is met; confirm registration mechanics with the Comptroller.
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace-facilitator rules can shift collection for facilitated sales
states.source_title: Maryland Comptroller – Sales and Use Tax Alert (Remote Sellers)

states.sales_basis: Massachusetts sales; marketplace-facilitated sales may be excluded when facilitator collects

states.sales_basis: Taxable and non-taxable sales into Michigan

states.source_title: Michigan Treasury – Remote Seller FAQ

states.sales_basis: Retail sales, generally excluding resale sales
states.collection_timing: First day of a calendar month no later than 60 days after meeting/exceeding threshold
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales are included in threshold; facilitator collects tax on facilitated sales
states.source_title: Minnesota DOR – Sales Tax for Remote Sellers
states.notes: Current Minnesota DOR guidance uses the prior 12-month period and illustrates successive monthly 12-month reviews (for example, Aug–Jul, then Sep–Aug). This supersedes the quarter-end convention shown in some secondary charts.

states.sales_basis: Gross sales into Mississippi
states.collection_timing: Register/collect beginning with the next applicable transaction after the threshold is exceeded, subject to current DOR guidance.
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales collected by facilitator are generally excluded from individual seller threshold

states.sales_basis: Taxable sales of tangible personal property, including marketplace sales

states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales are included for economic-nexus measurement; facilitator may collect on facilitated sales
states.source_title: Missouri DOR – Remote Seller and Marketplace Facilitator FAQs
states.notes: Current Missouri DOR FAQ directs a quarter-end review of the preceding 12-month period. Missouri regulation 12 CSR 10-114.100 describes economic nexus by previous or current calendar year. The analyzer follows the DOR's current operational FAQ for conservative screening; final Missouri conclusions should reconcile the FAQ and regulation with current DOR guidance.

states.sales_basis: Taxable gross receipts sourced to New Mexico

states.sales_basis: Gross sales into North Carolina
states.collection_timing: Effective 2026-07-02, a remote seller whose sole North Carolina nexus basis is exceeding the $100,000 sales threshold becomes engaged in business on the first day of the first calendar month occurring at least 60 days after exceeding the threshold; physical presence or another nexus basis can require earlier collection.
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales are included in threshold; facilitator collects on facilitated sales
states.source_title: North Carolina DOR – Remote Sales
states.notes: 200-transaction threshold removed effective 2024-07-01. Session Law 2026-31 added an extended compliance period effective 2026-07-02 for sellers engaged solely by exceeding the sales threshold; physical presence or another statutory nexus basis can require earlier collection.

states.sales_basis: Taxable sales delivered into North Dakota
states.collection_timing: Following calendar year or 60 days after threshold is met, whichever is earlier
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace facilitator has a comparable $100,000 threshold
states.source_title: North Dakota Tax Commissioner – Sales and Use Tax
states.notes: The 200-transaction test was repealed effective July 1, 2019; current small-seller exception is based on taxable sales exceeding $100,000.

states.sales_basis: Retail sales / gross receipts within Ohio statutory definitions
states.collection_timing: Begin collection on the next day after the economic-nexus threshold is met, subject to current Ohio registration procedures.
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales can count toward threshold; facilitator collection applies to facilitated sales
states.source_title: Ohio Revised Code – Section 5741.01
states.notes: Ohio retains the 200-transaction alternative.

states.sales_basis: Taxable sales of products into Oklahoma
states.collection_timing: First calendar month following month threshold is met
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace-facilitator rules apply separately

states.sales_basis: No general state sales/use tax
states.collection_timing: No Oregon general sales-tax collection requirement
states.marketplace_note: N/A for general sales tax
states.source_title: Oregon DOR – Sales Tax in Oregon
states.notes: Certain local/special taxes may apply.

states.sales_basis: Gross sales for the applicable seller type. A marketplace seller generally uses direct sales plus facilitated sales for which the facilitator does not collect; a marketplace facilitator uses facilitated and direct sales.
states.collection_timing: For ongoing years, determine economic presence from the prior calendar year; collection generally begins April 1 of the following year under PA DOR operational guidance.
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace treatment is role-specific: facilitators generally include facilitated and direct sales; marketplace sellers generally exclude facilitated sales when the facilitator collects on their behalf.
states.source_title: Pennsylvania DOR – Online Retailers
states.notes: Pennsylvania Act 13 of 2019 uses “at least $100,000” during the preceding twelve-month calendar period. Current PA DOR operational guidance measures the threshold by prior calendar year and applies the ongoing April 1–March 31 collection cycle. The analyzer uses the current DOR calendar-year method and the statutory >= $100,000 boundary.

states.sales_basis: Gross sales into Rhode Island

states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales can count toward threshold; facilitator collection applies
states.source_title: Rhode Island Division of Taxation – Remote Sellers
states.notes: Mandatory registration replaced earlier notice/reporting election regime.

states.sales_basis: Gross revenue from South Carolina sales
states.collection_timing: First day of second calendar month after economic nexus is established
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales can count toward threshold; facilitator rules apply
states.source_title: South Carolina DOR – Remote Sellers
states.notes: No transaction-count alternative.

states.collection_timing: First day of third month following month threshold is met
states.marketplace_note: Marketplace sales collected by facilitator are generally excluded from individual seller threshold after 2020 change
states.source_title: Tennessee DOR – Out-of-State Dealers / Marketplace Facilitators
states.notes: Threshold reduced from $500,000 to $100,000 effective 2020-10-01.

states.sales_basis: Gross revenue including taxable, nontaxable, and tax-exempt Texas sales

The analyzer uses >$500,000 as the principal rule and conservatively flags exactly $500,000 for human review.

states.sales_basis: Gross revenue from sales into Utah

source_url_audit_status: 51/51 primary-source URLs verified as current official/state-authorized web destinations or current official indexed resources on 2026-08-08. Future agency URL changes cannot be guaranteed.
transaction_analysis_note: v1.3.1 provides browser-only conservative economic-nexus early-warning screening of simplified transaction files using audited structured threshold logic and jurisdiction measurement periods. A below-modeled-threshold result is based only on imported data and the modeled economic-nexus test and is not a no-nexus/no-tax-obligation conclusion.
rules_logic_audit_note: v1.3.0 post-update audit: v1.2.1 findings remain addressed; structured threshold/operator/AND-OR/measurement controls reconcile 51 jurisdictions, with documented primary-source overrides and boundary-review safeguards retained.
post_update_audit_status: PASS - v1.3.0 rules/data post-update audit retained; v1.3.1 scope/UX hardening regression-tested without substantive jurisdiction-rule changes.
scope_clarity_review_status: Pass — professional-use scope/limitations disclosure converted to an on-demand bullet-point modal; prior v1.3.2 rule and UI controls retained.
